description: Python client (src/llm/client.py): emit the opaque X-Whale2-Affinity-Key header ONLY for chat-family lanes, so consecutive turns of the same runtime conversation pin to one gateway account. The value is derived from ERIS_RUNTIME_SESSION_ID (same env X-Session-ID uses), gated behind the SAME web_session_mode check that guards X-Session-ID (not when mode is off/disabled/none/0/legacy), and behind a new kill-switch ERIS_CHAT_ACCOUNT_AFFINITY (default on = 1; 0 = never send the header = exact current behavior). A SEPARATE chat-only lane set is used (NOT _PERSISTENT_WEB_SESSION_LANES, which includes autonomous/inner/private_mind/daydream and must not be pinned). Depends on FEAT-001 for the header name/semantics (X-Whale2-Affinity-Key); Python tests here are self-contained and do not invoke the Go gateway.
steps: In src/llm/client.py, add a NEW module-level frozenset near _PERSISTENT_WEB_SESSION_LANES: `_CHAT_AFFINITY_LANES = frozenset({"chat_main", "chat", "chat_tool_required"})`. Do NOT reuse or widen _PERSISTENT_WEB_SESSION_LANES. Support a comma-separated env override ERIS_CHAT_AFFINITY_LANES, mirroring how _web_session_header handles ERIS_WEB_SESSION_PERSISTENT_LANES (split on commas, strip+lower each item, fall back to the default set when the env is empty).

Add a helper `_chat_affinity_key() -> str` in src/llm/client.py: if os.environ ERIS_CHAT_ACCOUNT_AFFINITY (default "1") is in {"0","false","off","no"} return ""; read runtime_session = os.environ ERIS_RUNTIME_SESSION_ID (strip) and return "" if empty; read lane via current_inference_context().lane (default "transport", lowered); if lane not in the (env-overridable) chat affinity lane set return ""; otherwise return _compact_session_component(runtime_session, limit=48) so the value is stable across turns of one conversation and distinct across conversations (consistent with how _web_session_header compacts the runtime session id).

In create_chat_completion's request-building block (the `if session_base and web_session_mode not in {"legacy","off","disabled","none","0"}:` block where `request_headers["X-Session-ID"] = lease.session_id` is set, ~line 855), after setting X-Session-ID add: `affinity = _chat_affinity_key()` and `if affinity: request_headers["X-Whale2-Affinity-Key"] = affinity`. This keeps the affinity header under the SAME web_session_mode gate as X-Session-ID and, because it is set on the per-attempt request_headers copy, it is re-applied on every retry attempt and every turn. Do NOT set the header anywhere else and do NOT set it for non-chat lanes.

Document the new envs inline where the other ERIS_WEB_SESSION_* envs are read (there is no central env doc file in the worktree). Add a concise comment near the ERIS_WEB_SESSION_MODE read (~line 800) and/or near _web_session_header's ERIS_RUNTIME_SESSION_ID read (~line 149) describing ERIS_CHAT_ACCOUNT_AFFINITY (default on = 1; 0 = never send X-Whale2-Affinity-Key = exact current behavior) and ERIS_CHAT_AFFINITY_LANES (override for the chat-only affinity lane set).

Add src/tests/test_chat_account_affinity_v1.py modeled on test_web_session_guard_v1.py's test_e2e_openai_client_passes_full_prompt_and_forks_on_new_root and test_off_mode_leaves_request_stateless: monkeypatch client_module._brokered_post to capture kwargs['headers'], and drive requests inside `with inference_context(lane, metadata=...)`. Cases: (a) two turns of the same session (lane 'chat_main', ERIS_RUNTIME_SESSION_ID fixed, ERIS_WEB_SESSION_MODE=isolated) both send X-Whale2-Affinity-Key and the two captured values are EQUAL; (b) a background lane (e.g. 'autonomous') sends NO X-Whale2-Affinity-Key; (c) with ERIS_CHAT_ACCOUNT_AFFINITY=0 a chat-lane request sends NO affinity header; (d) with ERIS_WEB_SESSION_MODE=off a chat-lane request sends NO affinity header.
acceptance_criteria: `python -c "import llm.client"` with PYTHONPATH=src imports cleanly (no syntax/name errors).
Running `python -m pytest -q src/tests/test_chat_account_affinity_v1.py` from the worktree root passes all four assertions (a-d).

Running `python -m pytest -q src/tests/test_web_session_guard_v1.py src/tests/test_elegant_runtime_hardening.py` from the worktree root still passes (existing session-header and lane-persistence behavior unchanged).
No change to _PERSISTENT_WEB_SESSION_LANES and no affinity header emitted for non-chat lanes or when the kill-switch is off.
findings: Implemented in src/llm/client.py. (1) Added module-level frozenset _CHAT_AFFINITY_LANES = {chat_main, chat, chat_tool_required} right after _PERSISTENT_WEB_SESSION_LANES; _PERSISTENT_WEB_SESSION_LANES was NOT widened. (2) New helper _chat_affinity_key() -> str: returns "" when kill-switch ERIS_CHAT_ACCOUNT_AFFINITY (default "1") is in {0,false,off,no}, when ERIS_RUNTIME_SESSION_ID is empty, or when the current lane (current_inference_context().lane, default 'transport', lowered) is not in the affinity lane set; the lane set is overridable via comma-separated ERIS_CHAT_AFFINITY_LANES (strip+lower each item, fall back to _CHAT_AFFINITY_LANES when empty), mirroring _web_session_header's ERIS_WEB_SESSION_PERSISTENT_LANES handling. The value is _compact_session_component(runtime_session, limit=48) -- same derivation/compaction X-Session-ID uses, so it is stable across turns of one conversation and distinct across conversations. (3) In create_chat_completion, inside the existing 'if session_base and web_session_mode not in {legacy,off,disabled,none,0}:' block, immediately after request_headers['X-Session-ID'] = lease.session_id, added: affinity = _chat_affinity_key(); if affinity: request_headers['X-Whale2-Affinity-Key'] = affinity. Header is set only here, on the per-attempt request_headers copy, so it re-applies on every retry/turn and is under the SAME web_session_mode gate as X-Session-ID. Header name matches FEAT-001 exactly: X-Whale2-Affinity-Key (opaque value). (4) Inline env docs added near the ERIS_WEB_SESSION_MODE read (documents ERIS_CHAT_ACCOUNT_AFFINITY and ERIS_CHAT_AFFINITY_LANES) plus a docstring on _chat_affinity_key. No TTS/vision/memory touched. New test file src/tests/test_chat_account_affinity_v1.py (4 cases a-d) passes; existing test_web_session_guard_v1.py + test_elegant_runtime_hardening.py (19 tests) still pass. Kill-switch off (ERIS_CHAT_ACCOUNT_AFFINITY=0) and web_session_mode off both suppress the header, preserving exact current behavior. Integration note: no gateway deploy performed; Go side already landed per FEAT-001.
